chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from some of our companions, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“The sunnah (prophetic tradition) regarding nūrah is once in fifteen days; and if twenty days come upon you and you have nothing, then borrow against Allah.”

key_terms.النُّورَةِ: depilatory substance used for removing hair
key_terms.اَلسُّنَّةُ: the normative sunnah (prophetic tradition) practice being prescribed
key_terms.خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ: a period of fifteen, indicating the recommended interval
key_terms.عَلَى اللَّهِ: with reliance upon Allah for repayment and support
key_terms.عِشْرُونَ: twenty days, marking the outer limit mentioned in the report
key_terms.فَاسْتَقْرِضْ: borrow, meaning to take a loan if necessary

ai.seo_question: What is the sunnah (prophetic tradition) timeframe for using nūrah according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the sunnah (prophetic tradition) regarding the use of nūrah, setting it at every fifteen days. It further emphasizes maintaining this practice even in hardship, to the extent of borrowing with trust in Allah.
